title: fix(components): a slotted page template draws only the regions it places, and full-width retires (objectui#12476)
body:
Fixes #12476
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx`, against `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.3 (`PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS`, `checkPageRegionPlacement`):

- **Slotted templates draw only what they place.** On `default`, `header-sidebar-main` and `three-column`, a region the template does not place is no longer stacked under `main`. It is drawn nowhere and never moved into another slot. Where it used to stack, the page shows a refusal (`data-page-refusal="unplaced-region"`) naming the region and the template's slots.
- **`full-width` retires.** `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` is now keyed by the spec's `PageTemplate`, so a template the spec adds or retires fails to compile. `FullWidthTemplate` is renamed `DefaultTemplate`. A template name the registry does not hold draws a refusal (`data-page-refusal="unregistered-template"`) instead of silently taking the pageType layout.
- **The spec floor moves.** `@object-ui/components` now reads the spec's `PAGE_TEMPLATE_SLOTS`, which `@objectstack/spec` 18.0.0-next.1 does not carry, so its declared range moves from `^18.0.0-next.1` to `^18.0.0-next.2` (the lockfile's one `specifier` line moves with it; the resolved version stays 18.0.0-next.3).
- **A pending changeset is corrected.** `.changeset/23610-record-page-seed-default.md` no longer says the renderer recognises `full-width`: a stored `full-width` row keeps rendering because the platform rewrites it to `default` on read. Three comments that named `FullWidthTemplate` or the old stacking are corrected too.
- **Unchanged:** `dashboard`'s open grid; the 12-column block grid in each placed region (objectui#12624); the narrow-region compact list (objectui#12703); the pageType dispatch (no template), which still stacks.

## Why a visible refusal, not drawing nothing

The spec migration rewrites only `full-width` to `default` on read. A stored row with an unplaced region is served unchanged, so it does reach the renderer. Drawing nothing would silently lose content. Stacking is the mis-layout the ruling retires. A visible refusal tells the author what to rename.

## Callers read (H3)

- The synthesized record page (`plugin-detail` `buildDefaultPageSchema`, `template: 'default'`, regions `main` and `aside` only) and approval pages: unaffected.
- PageView and PagePreview spread the raw stored row with no parse: they get the new behaviour for slotted templates.
- Preview samples and examples carry no template: pageType path, unchanged.
- No in-repo producer emits `full-width`.

## Tests

- New `page-template-slots-12476.test.tsx`: 16 tests. 7 pin the refusals, 9 are controls.
- Ablation: with page.tsx reverted to the main blob, 7 failed and 9 passed. Restored by HEAD blob hash, 16/16.
- Moved pin: `layout-default-jsdoc-7361` row 7 now reads `DefaultTemplate` (rename only).
- No pin asserted that an unplaced region is stacked.
- Families naming the page renderer: 66 files, 1447 tests green.
- `@object-ui/components` test: 4036 green.
- Live reading: NOT MEASURED. Reason: it needs the console dev server and a seeded preview route.

## Acceptance notes

- Studio's "Add region" (`PageBlockCanvas` addRegion) writes `region_N`, which the save door refuses on a `default` or template-less page. Reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- The template-less pageType path still stacks, although the spec judges such a page as `default`. Left as is per the claim's surface.
- The objectstack migration's "renders as before" sentence no longer holds for unplaced regions.
